lead: Hemant Soren is best known as an Indian politician, born on 10 August 1975 in Ramgarh district.
As of 2026, he is 51 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Jharkhand Legislative Assembly and member of Rajya Sabha.
This profile collects the Hemant facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Hemant Soren — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Hemant Soren was born on 10 August 1975 in Ramgarh district, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Shibu Soren. He is a sibling of Durga Soren, Anjani Soren and Basant Soren.
He received his education at Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan.

sections.heading: Hemant Soren — Career and Professional Work
paras: Hemant Soren works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Jharkhand Legislative Assembly (2009–2014), member of Rajya Sabha (2009–2010), Deputy Chief Minister of Jharkhand (2010–2013), Chief Minister of Jharkhand (2013–2014), Member of the Jharkhand Legislative Assembly (2014–2022) and Member of the Jharkhand Legislative Assembly (2019–2020). He is affiliated with Jharkhand Mukti Morcha.
